title: Ngbaka Manza | Ethnologue Free
text: Ngbaka Manza is a stable indigenous language of the Central African Republic. It belongs to the Niger-Congo language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community.
